Model test-vectors/models/cop1.py, written blind (TV-023) by a Claude agent from the Blue Books and docs/ only, without reading any implementation; docs/verification/reviews/cop1-tables.md was read as input and the transcription compared with it. For the file layout and schema change only, its author also read crates/aldis-testkit and the schema generator, which are test infrastructure and not an implementation under test. Each setup is the shortest input sequence found by breadth-first search over the model's input alphabet, shared by the scenarios that start from it; the expected outputs are the model's. The file is written by the model (--write) and never edited by hand.
